title: Saving a localization run
description: You can follow stored arrays and selected heatmaps into artifact files.

steps.description: You create artifacts if needed and save the maze and run arrays into one NPZ archive. The named entries include beliefs, smoothed values and true states.
save_heat renders a grid, saves its figure under artifacts and closes the figure. You pass the file name and title into this helper.

steps.question: Does this block save one heatmap for every belief?
steps.answer: No. It selects the first, middle and last beliefs for three heatmap calls.

steps.description: The supplied directory listing includes the NPZ archive and three PNG files. You see belief_t8.png as the selected middle image in this recording.
